high_level_goal.name: Ensure Efficient Review and Approval of Citizen Reports
high_level_goal.description: Enable the Organization Office to review, approve, or reject citizen reports with mandatory explanations for rejections, ensuring accountability and quality control.

actor.name: Organization Office Staff
actor.description: Staff responsible for reviewing and approving citizen reports.

low_level_goals.name: Review citizen report for approval or rejection
low_level_goals.description: Organization Office Staff reviews a citizen report and decides to approve or reject it with mandatory explanation for rejection.

parsed_response.rationale: The reconstruction accurately captures the review, approval, and rejection logic.

The child llg_001 correctly captures the core functionality of the parent HLG as described in the source (Section B: Report Lifecycle). The source specifies that the Organization Office performs a preliminary review, marking reports as accepted or rejected, and requires a written explanation for rejections. The child covers both the decision-making and the mandatory explanation requirement. No other capabilities from the parent are missing, and there are no unsupported or redundant actions.
